name: Stromgarde Badges
summary: In Stromgarde, the Syndicate pays for militia badges taken from the fallen. At Refuge Pointe, Captain Nials wants them brought back.

sections.title: A Bounty on Soldiers
sections.body: The Syndicate fights a contingent of militia in Stromgarde. Its leaders offer gold for every badge taken from a slain militiaman, hoping to turn their followers against the better-trained soldiers. Captain Nials calls the Syndicate cutthroats and refuses to let them keep trophies from the brave fallen. You enter the part of Stromgarde they hold and bring the badges back to Refuge Pointe. Nials wants them to learn they cannot profit from the dead.

sections.title: After the Hunt
sections.body: Captain Nials promises to tell the fallen militiamen's relatives that their kin died in battle. The news is grim, but he believes it is better than leaving a family to wonder what became of someone who went missing.

faq.q: Why does the Syndicate want Stromgarde badges?
faq.answer: Syndicate leaders offer gold for every badge taken from a fallen militiaman. They hope the payment will drive their followers to fight the better-trained troops.
You find the badges in the part of Stromgarde controlled by the Syndicate.

faq.q: Who orders the retrieval of the badges?
faq.answer: Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe orders the badges recovered. She will not let the Syndicate keep trophies from the fallen militia.
